31: /-- The diameter of a set in a pseudoemetric space as an extended nonnegative real number. -/
32: noncomputable def ediam (s : Set X) :=
33:   ⨆ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s), edist x y
34: 
35: theorem ediam_eq_sSup (s : Set X) : ediam s = sSup (image2 edist s s) := sSup_image2.symm
36: 
37: theorem ediam_le_iff {d : ℝ≥0∞} : ediam s ≤ d ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, edist x y ≤ d := by
38:   simp only [ediam, iSup_le_iff]
39: 
40: theorem ediam_image_le_iff {d : ℝ≥0∞} {f : α → X} {s : Set α} :
41:     ediam (f '' s) ≤ d ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, edist (f x) (f y) ≤ d := by
42:   simp only [ediam_le_iff, forall_mem_image]
43: 
44: theorem edist_le_of_ediam_le {d} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) (hd : ediam s ≤ d) : edist x y ≤ d :=
45:   ediam_le_iff.1 hd x hx y hy
46: 
47: /-- If two points belong to some set, their edistance is bounded by the diameter of the set -/
48: theorem edist_le_ediam_of_mem (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : edist x y ≤ ediam s :=
49:   edist_le_of_ediam_le hx hy le_rfl
50: 
51: /-- If the distance between any two points in a set is bounded by some constant, this constant
52: bounds the diameter. -/
53: theorem ediam_le {d : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, edist x y ≤ d) : ediam s ≤ d :=
54:   ediam_le_iff.2 h
55: 
56: /-- The diameter of a subsingleton vanishes. -/
57: theorem ediam_subsingleton (hs : s.Subsingleton) : ediam s = 0 :=
58:   nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <| ediam_le fun _x hx y hy => (hs hx hy).symm ▸ edist_self y ▸ le_rfl
59: 
60: alias _root_.Set.Subsingleton.ediam_eq := ediam_subsingleton
61: 
62: /-- The diameter of the empty set vanishes -/
63: @[simp]
64: theorem ediam_empty : ediam (∅ : Set X) = 0 :=
65:   ediam_subsingleton subsingleton_empty
66: 
67: /-- The extended diameter of a singleton vanishes -/
68: @[simp]
69: theorem ediam_singleton : ediam ({x} : Set X) = 0 :=
70:   ediam_subsingleton subsingleton_singleton
71: 
72: @[to_additive (attr := simp)]
73: theorem ediam_one [One X] : ediam (1 : Set X) = 0 :=
74:   ediam_singleton
75: 
76: theorem ediam_iUnion_mem_option {ι : Type*} (o : Option ι) (s : ι → Set X) :
77:     ediam (⋃ i ∈ o, s i) = ⨆ i ∈ o, ediam (s i) := by cases o <;> simp
78: 
79: theorem ediam_insert : ediam (insert x s) = max (⨆ y ∈ s, edist x y) (ediam s) :=
80:   eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun d => by simp +contextual [ediam_le_iff, edist_comm]
81: 
82: theorem ediam_pair : ediam {x, y} = edist x y := by simp [ediam_insert]
83: 
84: theorem ediam_triple : ediam {x, y, z} = max (max (edist x y) (edist x z)) (edist y z) := by
85:   simp only [ediam_insert, iSup_insert, iSup_singleton, ediam_singleton, max_zero]
86: 
87: /-- The extended diameter is monotonous with respect to inclusion -/
88: @[gcongr]
89: theorem ediam_mono (h : s ⊆ t) : ediam s ≤ ediam t :=
90:   ediam_le fun _x hx _y hy => edist_le_ediam_of_mem (h hx) (h hy)
91: 
92: /-- The extended diameter of a union is controlled by the diameter of the sets,
93: and the edistance between two points in the sets. -/
94: theorem ediam_union_le_add_edist (xs : x ∈ s) (yt : y ∈ t) :
95:     ediam (s ∪ t) ≤ ediam s + edist x y + ediam t := by
96:   have A : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, edist a b ≤ ediam s + edist x y + ediam t := fun a ha b hb =>
97:     calc
98:       edist a b ≤ edist a x + edist x y + edist y b := edist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
99:       _ ≤ ediam s + edist x y + ediam t := by
